verdict: consistent on the text as enciphered (tentative where marked): 64 signs including the 5 margin signs, 58 aligned to 58 letters, 53/53 repeated-shape occurrences on their letter; هن (not هيف), لي (not بي), صلب (not صلت); ناعم عريض completed from the l.7 margin through the arc (insertion) mark; the l.8 arc word (record حزين) not read
notes: Rows 5-8 of image 0084_0134 (16 + 15 + 14 + 14 = 59, as the record) and the two margin groups level with l.7 (3 signs: سا | dumbbell, small loop) and l.8 (2 signs), 64 signs. Plain 1.3x half-line zooms, 2x on the arcs and the margin. Keyed as enciphered: (1) the second word is 2 signs, Ls Ne; Ne is ن in ثمان and وحنين (twice), Ls is ه in فيه and اليه, so the word is هن (ذات هن فيه خصال ثمان: "she has a thing with eight qualities"; the eight adjectives follow); (2) بي is Lk N9, and Lk is ل in خصال, اليه, صلب: لي اليه تشوق; (3) صلت ends in the pentagon, which is ب in ابيض: صلب ("firm"); (4) تشوق is one group (no divider seen between ت and شوق). The arc groups: in l.7 ناعم عريض has 6 main-line signs: Ne Ra Db + Ha (ha-curve under an arc) + N9 Eb. Read with the margin: Ne Ra Db (ن ا ع) + margin سا (م) | Db Lp (ع ر) + N9 Eb (ي ض) gives ناعم عريض with the margin divider at the word break and the dumbbell ع both times; Ha is then the insertion mark and is not counted as a letter (tentative: the margin as an insertion is inferred from the fit). In l.8 the group after ناشف has Ib (under an arc), N9, D6 = ?, ي, ق with the key, and the margin pair Rh Ne = ?, ن; together they do not give حزين (a word like انيق would fit ? ن ي ق but Rh is not alif elsewhere); left unread, 5 signs unaligned. ي is the 9-loop (8), ن the hooked loop (8), alif the 2-hook (7).
